messages:
olivia: Quick heads-up — CloudRun partner wants to go live on their marketplace next month. can we bundle the listing launch with a joint benchmark post + a short webinar? looking for a go/no-go timeline.

jay: Love that. timeline? we need product + eng signoff on the sandbox model before any benchmarks. :calendar:

maya: I can own the benchmark narrative and landing page copy. need the test corpus and perf numbers by EOW. short, results-first.

samir: From eng side: sandbox model ready but need a quantization run and latency sweep. ETA 4 business days. we should avoid long sequence lengths for the benchmark.

emily: Webinar ops: preferred date slots? Partner prefers Tue/Wed mornings (PT). do we want it recorded live or pre-recorded demo + live q&a?

derek: Recommend recorded demo + 20m live Q&A. reduces risk and gives a clean clip for socials.

olivia: good — aim for Tue 2pm PT, record-demo + 20m Q&A. maya, can the blog + benchmark draft align with webinar teaser?

maya: yes, draft will include: TL;DR, methodology, key perf chart, cost per 1k tokens, and integration notes. will add a short how-to for listing in the marketplace.

olivia: on leads — partner wants inbound leads from marketplace routed to their SDRs but we also want MQLs in our SFDC. need routing rules and webhook.

ops-bot: Reminder: sensitive customer data must NOT be proxied to partner without POA. see https://confluence/redwood/privacy-guidelines

jay: For routing, propose 1) marketplace leads -> partner webhook (only name, company, email, use-case), 2) copy to Redwood SFDC as lead with lead_source=partner_marketplace, 3) tag with campaign id.

emily: can we use our inbound microform so we get consent checkbox? partner agrees.

derek: Ops note: webhook URL + auth token will be provisioned by partner. security requires ephemeral token rotation every 30d.

olivia: maya/jay/samir/emily/derek — action items and owners:
- maya: benchmark draft + landing copy (due 5 business)
- samir: quantization + latency sweep + final perf numbers (due 4 business)
- jay: sandbox model signoff + integration checklist (due 3 business)
- emily: webinar ops + registration page + recording plan (due 7 business)
- derek: lead routing spec + security checklist + sample webhook payload (due 2 business)

maya: noted. will include a small methodology appendix for reproducibility.

samir: will run the latency sweep today and drop raw logs in the team S3 under s3://redwood-partners/cloudrun/sweeps/2876543210

derek: sample webhook payload (will hand off to partner):
```
POST /partner-webhook HTTP/1.1
Host: webhook.partner-inc.com
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral-token>
{
  "name": "Jane Doe",
  "company": "ACME Corp",
  "email": "jane@example.com",
  "interest": "integration help",
  "consent": true,
  "campaign_id": "cr-2026-03-28"
}
```

olivia: perfect. Derek — can you also add a route that copies the lead into SFDC and tags it with campaign_id? simple mapping ok.

derek: yep. will add mapping: campaign_id -> Campaign__c, lead_source=partner_marketplace. will also add a light validation for consent flag.

emily: marketing checklist for the launch:
- partner blog cross-post (copy + images)
- benchmark post on our blog + charts (SEO)
- webinar registration page + Cadence email 1/2/7 days
- social teaser + 1-pager for sales
- tracking UTM params for all links

olivia: good. final sync: Thurs 10am PT to walk through the landing, sample webhook, and promo timeline. please drop any blockers here before EOD. :raised_hands:
